theory.title: Wish and if only
theory.explanation: This mission develops the language of 021. At B2, express relationships, degrees of certainty and contrasting perspectives precisely. Use the target structure to connect ideas rather than producing isolated sentences.

patterns.label: Wish and if only
patterns.pattern: wish / if only + past or past perfect
examples: I wish I were more patient.
If only I had asked for clarification.

patterns.label: Qualification
patterns.pattern: It could be argued that… / To some extent… / The evidence appears to suggest that…
examples: It could be argued that the proposal is effective in the short term.
The evidence appears to suggest that further evaluation is needed.

theory.tip: Avoid absolute claims unless the evidence justifies them. Vary sentence openings, use precise vocabulary and check that complex clauses remain easy to follow.

phrases.english: A key issue is how decisions are justified.

content.passage: The question of 021 has become increasingly relevant, particularly for people working towards more informed and responsible decisions. At the outset, the group assumed that the issue would be straightforward. A closer examination, however, revealed that recent evidence needed to be considered alongside practical experience. The review included people from different backgrounds, and participants repeatedly valued clear explanations and fair access to information. One concern was that short-term figures could be misleading if they were separated from their wider context. The team therefore compared several perspectives rather than relying on a single account. Experts recommended testing proposals locally before introducing them on a larger scale. The pilot suggested that modest adjustments could improve engagement, although the results were not identical in every setting. The report also highlighted the importance of transparent communication and clearly defined responsibilities. Its authors argued that decisions should reflect more than one perspective and should be supported by relevant evidence. Ultimately, progress in 021 depends on careful evaluation, open discussion and a willingness to revise an approach when new information becomes available.

One concern was that short-term figures could be misleading if they were separated from their wider context. The team therefore compared several perspectives rather than relying on a single account. Experts recommended testing proposals locally before introducing them on a larger scale. The pilot suggested that modest adjustments could improve engagement, although the results were not identical in every setting. The report also highlighted the importance of transparent communication and clearly defined responsibilities. Its authors argued that decisions should reflect more than one perspective and should be supported by relevant evidence. Ultimately, progress in 022 depends on careful evaluation, open discussion and a willingness to revise an approach when new information becomes available.

theory.title: Conditionals and concession
theory.explanation: This mission develops the language of 024. At B2, express relationships, degrees of certainty and contrasting perspectives precisely. Use the target structure to connect ideas rather than producing isolated sentences.

patterns.label: Conditionals and concession
patterns.pattern: if / unless / provided that / although
examples: If access improves, participation will rise.
Although the plan is costly, it may be worthwhile.

patterns.label: Qualification
patterns.pattern: It could be argued that… / To some extent… / The evidence appears to suggest that…
examples: It could be argued that the proposal is effective in the short term.
The evidence appears to suggest that further evaluation is needed.

theory.tip: Avoid absolute claims unless the evidence justifies them. Vary sentence openings, use precise vocabulary and check that complex clauses remain easy to follow.

content.passage: The question of 025 has become increasingly relevant, particularly for people working towards more informed and responsible decisions. At the outset, the group assumed that the issue would be straightforward. A closer examination, however, revealed that recent evidence needed to be considered alongside practical experience. The review included people from different backgrounds, and participants repeatedly valued clear explanations and fair access to information. One concern was that short-term figures could be misleading if they were separated from their wider context. The team therefore compared several perspectives rather than relying on a single account. Experts recommended testing proposals locally before introducing them on a larger scale. The pilot suggested that modest adjustments could improve engagement, although the results were not identical in every setting. The report also highlighted the importance of transparent communication and clearly defined responsibilities. Its authors argued that decisions should reflect more than one perspective and should be supported by relevant evidence. Ultimately, progress in 025 depends on careful evaluation, open discussion and a willingness to revise an approach when new information becomes available.

theory.title: Participle clauses
theory.explanation: This mission develops the language of 026. At B2, express relationships, degrees of certainty and contrasting perspectives precisely. Use the target structure to connect ideas rather than producing isolated sentences.

patterns.label: Participle clauses
patterns.pattern: -ing / having + past participle
examples: Having considered both sides, she changed her mind.
Faced with criticism, he responded calmly.

patterns.label: Qualification
patterns.pattern: It could be argued that… / To some extent… / The evidence appears to suggest that…
examples: It could be argued that the proposal is effective in the short term.
The evidence appears to suggest that further evaluation is needed.

theory.tip: Avoid absolute claims unless the evidence justifies them. Vary sentence openings, use precise vocabulary and check that complex clauses remain easy to follow.

Experts recommended testing proposals locally before introducing them on a larger scale. The pilot suggested that modest adjustments could improve engagement, although the results were not identical in every setting. The report also highlighted the importance of transparent communication and clearly defined responsibilities. Its authors argued that decisions should reflect more than one perspective and should be supported by relevant evidence. Ultimately, progress in 026 depends on careful evaluation, open discussion and a willingness to revise an approach when new information becomes available.

The pilot suggested that modest adjustments could improve engagement, although the results were not identical in every setting. The report also highlighted the importance of transparent communication and clearly defined responsibilities. Its authors argued that decisions should reflect more than one perspective and should be supported by relevant evidence. content.passage: The question of 028 has become increasingly relevant, particularly for people working towards more informed and responsible decisions. At the outset, the group assumed that the issue would be straightforward. A closer examination, however, revealed that recent evidence needed to be considered alongside practical experience. The review included people from different backgrounds, and participants repeatedly valued clear explanations and fair access to information. One concern was that short-term figures could be misleading if they were separated from their wider context. The team therefore compared several perspectives rather than relying on a single account. Experts recommended testing proposals locally before introducing them on a larger scale. The pilot suggested that modest adjustments could improve engagement, although the results were not identical in every setting. The report also highlighted the importance of transparent communication and clearly defined responsibilities. Its authors argued that decisions should reflect more than one perspective and should be supported by relevant evidence. Ultimately, progress in 028 depends on careful evaluation, open discussion and a willingness to revise an approach when new information becomes available.

theory.title: Gerund and infinitive patterns
theory.explanation: This mission develops the language of 029. At B2, express relationships, degrees of certainty and contrasting perspectives precisely. Use the target structure to connect ideas rather than producing isolated sentences.

patterns.label: Gerund and infinitive patterns
patterns.pattern: verb + -ing / verb + to-infinitive
examples: Some people avoid making assumptions.
She agreed to reconsider her view.

patterns.label: Qualification
patterns.pattern: It could be argued that… / To some extent… / The evidence appears to suggest that…
examples: It could be argued that the proposal is effective in the short term.
The evidence appears to suggest that further evaluation is needed.

theory.tip: Avoid absolute claims unless the evidence justifies them. Vary sentence openings, use precise vocabulary and check that complex clauses remain easy to follow.

phrases.spanish: Una cuestión clave es cómo se justifican las decisiones.

One concern was that short-term figures could be misleading if they were separated from their wider context. The team therefore compared several perspectives rather than relying on a single account. Experts recommended testing proposals locally before introducing them on a larger scale. The pilot suggested that modest adjustments could improve engagement, although the results were not identical in every setting. The report also highlighted the importance of transparent communication and clearly defined responsibilities. Its authors argued that decisions should reflect more than one perspective and should be supported by relevant evidence. Ultimately, progress in 029 depends on careful evaluation, open discussion and a willingness to revise an approach when new information becomes available.

theory.explanation: This mission develops the language of 030. At B2, express relationships, degrees of certainty and contrasting perspectives precisely. Use the target structure to connect ideas rather than producing isolated sentences.

patterns.label: Qualification
patterns.pattern: It could be argued that… / To some extent… / The evidence appears to suggest that…

content.passage: The question of 030 has become increasingly relevant, particularly for people working towards more informed and responsible decisions. At the outset, the group assumed that the issue would be straightforward. A closer examination, however, revealed that recent evidence needed to be considered alongside practical experience. The review included people from different backgrounds, and participants repeatedly valued clear explanations and fair access to information. One concern was that short-term figures could be misleading if they were separated from their wider context. The team therefore compared several perspectives rather than relying on a single account. Experts recommended testing proposals locally before introducing them on a larger scale. The pilot suggested that modest adjustments could improve engagement, although the results were not identical in every setting. The report also highlighted the importance of transparent communication and clearly defined responsibilities. Its authors argued that decisions should reflect more than one perspective and should be supported by relevant evidence. Ultimately, progress in 030 depends on careful evaluation, open discussion and a willingness to revise an approach when new information becomes available.
